grid.title: Relação de Entradas
grid.expression: SELECT CAB.NUNOTA, CAB.CODEMP, CAB.NUMNOTA, CAB.CODTIPOPER, (SELECT MAX(TOP2.DESCROPER) FROM TGFTOP TOP2 WHERE TOP2.CODTIPOPER = CAB.CODTIPOPER) AS DESCROPER, CAB.DTENTSAI, CAB.CODPARC, PAR.NOMEPARC, ITE.CODPROD, PRO.DESCRPROD, PRO.CODVOL, ITE.QTDNEG, (ITE.QTDNEG - ITE.QTDENTREGUE) AS PENDENTE, ITE.VLRUNIT, CASE WHEN NVL(ITE.QTDNEG, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE NVL(ITE.VLRIPI, 0) / ITE.QTDNEG END AS VLRIPI, CASE WHEN NVL(ITE.QTDNEG, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE NVL(ITE.VLRICMS, 0) / ITE.QTDNEG END AS VLRICMS, (CASE WHEN CAB.CODEMP = 501 THEN ITE.VLRUNIT WHEN ITE.AD_VLRCHEIOCOM IS NULL THEN ITE.VLRUNIT ELSE (CASE WHEN VOA.CODPROD IS NULL THEN ITE.AD_VLRCHEIOCOM WHEN VOA.DIVIDEMULTIPLICA = 'D' THEN ITE.AD_VLRCHEIOCOM * VOA.QUANTIDADE ELSE ITE.AD_VLRCHEIOCOM / VOA.QUANTIDADE END) END) AS VLRCHEIO, NVL(ITE.ALIQICMS,0) AS ALIQICMS, NVL(ITE.ALIQIPI,0) AS ALIQIPI, NVL(ITE.VLRSUBST,0) AS VLRSUBST, USU.NOMEUSU AS INCLUSOR, NAT.DESCRNAT, PRO.ESTMIN, III.VLRIMPOSTO / ITE.QTDNEG AS VLRIMPOSTO, III.VLRDESPADUA / ITE.QTDNEG AS VLRDESPADUA, IDI.VLRPISIMP / ITE.QTDNEG AS VLRPISIMP, IDI.VLRCOFINSIMP / ITE.QTDNEG AS VLRCOFINSIMP FROM TGFITE ITE INNER JOIN TGFCAB CAB ON ITE.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA INNER JOIN TGFPAR PAR ON CAB.CODPARC = PAR.CODPARC INNER JOIN TGFPRO PRO ON ITE.CODPROD = PRO.CODPROD LEFT JOIN TSIUSU USU ON CAB.CODUSUINC = USU.CODUSU INNER JOIN TGFNAT NAT ON CAB.CODNAT = NAT.CODNAT INNER JOIN TGFGRU GRU ON PRO.CODGRUPOPROD = GRU.CODGRUPOPROD LEFT JOIN TGFVOA VOA ON (VOA.CODPROD = ITE.CODPROD AND VOA.CODVOL = ITE.CODVOL AND ((ITE.CONTROLE IS NULL AND VOA.CONTROLE = ' ') OR (ITE.CONTROLE IS NOT NULL AND ITE.CONTROLE = VOA.CONTROLE))) LEFT JOIN TGFIII III ON (III.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA AND III.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA) LEFT JOIN TGFIDI IDI ON (IDI.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA AND IDI.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA) WHERE (CAB.CODPARC = :P_CODPARC OR :P_CODPARC IS NULL) AND (ITE.CODPROD = :P_CODPROD OR :P_CODPROD IS NULL) AND (CAB.DTENTSAI >= :P_PERIODO.INI AND CAB.DTENTSAI <= :P_PERIODO.FIN) AND (CAB.TIPMOV IN ('C','D')) AND CAB.STATUSNOTA = 'L' AND (CAB.CODNAT = :P_CODNAT OR :P_CODNAT IS NULL) AND ((SUBSTR(PRO.CODGRUPOPROD,0,4) = SUBSTR(:P_CODGRUPOPROD,0,4)) OR :P_CODGRUPOPROD IS NULL) AND (CAB.CODEMP = :P_CODEMP OR :P_CODEMP IS NULL) ORDER BY CAB.DTENTSAI, CAB.NUNOTA, CAB.CODEMP, CAB.CODPARC, CAB.NUMNOTA
